profile_text.body:
Synopsys is a public company headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, traded under the ticker SNPS and identified in SEC filings by CIK 0000883241. Its site describes it as delivering comprehensive silicon-to-systems solutions that help innovators accelerate development, reduce risk, and drive breakthroughs, and it presents its work under the headings of EDA tools, semiconductor IP and systems verification. A site item dated to SAFE Forum 2026 covers advances in power and performance for AI and multi-die designs on the latest Samsung Foundry processes.

The site also carries an AI-powered chatbot that provides general information about Synopsys, including its products and services. The accompanying notice states that the chatbot may be incorrect or incomplete, that the terms of applicable agreements supersede anything it says, and that chats may be accessed by Synopsys and its service providers to customize the experience and improve the tool.

The company's recorded litigation exposure is in California, with 270 cases. No individual cases, product listings, or MCP servers are recorded for it.
